sharedProposal.realBodiesAndMatter: KEEP one physical identity for every creature, object, container and material lot. A creature is not a nonliving object merely because it is Undead, Construct, Petrified, unconscious or temporarily object-shaped. A genuinely dead body retains its actual corpse identity and old resource restrictions. Actual worn/held/carried noncreature belongings, including independently lawful melded possessions, keep their quantity, damage, age, ownership and paid history. sharedProposal.movementAndGeometry: KEEP real support, occupied volume, source-qualified movement prevention and actual endpoint wards. Approaching a portal still spends movement and can provoke under actual ordinary rules. Explicit remote-destination exceptions below waive only the stated originating path/line-of-effect requirement. They grant no sight through walls or topology between planes. Movement groups resolve atomically with all their actual gear: no split arrivals, cargo deletion, post-failure alternate-square choice or second copy. At genuine lost support use existing Falling. A source created by a spell does not automatically make every later mundane collision or supplied natural attack magical. Actual HP payment is not damage. preparedCompleteRecord.name: Warding Bond

operational.targets: One willing ally other than yourself, perceived within range and line of effect. Neither participant may already participate in another Warding Bond, as caster or protected ally.
operational.duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute. In initiative, expires at the caster's tenth future regular-start marker after application; retain that virtual marker through initiative changes, departure or death. Outside initiative, expires 60 seconds after application; entering initiative preserves that absolute deadline. An already-passed start never counts. Ends earlier when concentration ends. Also ends if either participant dies. Reaching 0 HP alone is not a separate ending condition; ordinary Incapacitated/concentration rules still apply.
operational.resolution: Automatic on legal casting. On each eligible positive incoming damage packet to the ally, apply the mandatory post-defense transfer described below; a rounded-zero transfer claims no transfer operation.
operational.effect: The ally gains +1 AC and +1 to saves, subject separately to the strongest applicable flat bonus. After the ally's defenses and legal prevention, before temporary HP, transfer floor(remaining damage / 2) to you and leave the remainder on the ally. Keep the damage type. Your transferred share skips a second mitigation/prevention stage and cannot transfer again; apply your temporary HP, HP, applicable life-state protections, Wounds and concentration consequences normally. The ally retains the hit, failed-save, critical and attached-rider identity; you were not hit and did not fail that save merely because damage transferred.
operational.scaling: None. The rank-2 duplicate grants no upgrade or extra effect.
operational.limitations: Use DAMAGE_SHARING_PLAYTEST.md: one transfer operation per original-recipient damage root, across all owners. A prior pre-mitigation split preempts this transfer; competing positive mandatory post-defense claims are chosen by the original target. The retained ally portion cannot subsequently be transferred again after this split. Complete the current packet's split and life consequences before concentration failure caused by that packet ends the bond; never undo a committed share. One Warding Bond per participating creature across all casters; casting cannot create chains or cycles. Initial range/line of effect are required, but no continuing distance or line-of-effect tether is imposed. This ordinary spell neither consumes nor increases the Paladin class redirection round ledger and grants none of its named healing/resource riders or proc permissions. Unrelated downstream triggers still require their own exact source authorization. Direct HP payments are not damage and cannot be transferred. Known/prepared access, class-level gates, legal components, line of effect, payment before resolution, concentration transitions, Dissonance, Refrain and class cadence follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. No automatic scaling or generic upcast.
operational.designNotes: PRESERVED: Action, 30 feet, concentration 1 minute, +1 AC/saves and half-damage sharing; M/F uses focus. NEW: willing ally, conserved mandatory post-defense split, rounding, participation and life endpoints, no continued tether and ordinary-spell/class-engine separation. CONFLICT RULING: source-derived class access is rank 1; duplicate rank-2 block is retained as evidence only.
operational.implementationStatus: REVIEWED authored operational-playtest manuscript; runtime and balance validation pending

preparedCompleteRecord.name: Conjure Water

operational.targets: One open container or unoccupied surface you can see within 30 feet; up to 1 gallon
operational.duration: Up to 1 hour; ends earlier if consumed, dispersed, or you cast Conjure Water again
operational.resolution: None.
operational.effect: Create up to 1 gallon of clean, drinkable water in the chosen legal location. A creature may satisfy its ordinary water need from Conjure Water once per 24 elapsed in-world hours. This replaces no food, equipment, camp supplies or abstract expedition Supply units.
operational.scaling: None. Damage dice, target count, range and duration do not automatically increase with character or class level.
operational.limitations: You can maintain only one batch of water from this spell at a time; casting it again causes any unconsumed prior conjured water to vanish. Cannot create water inside a creature, sealed object, occupied body space, machinery, or a location where creation itself would deal damage. Conjured water cannot be sold, stockpiled beyond the one active batch, fermented into permanent commodities, or count as a permanent crafting/industrial ingredient. It provides ordinary hydration while it exists. Repeated cantrip casts use shared Refrain rules. Consuming or replacing batches never bypasses the once-per-recipient-per-24-hours hydration limit. Conjured water in a creature does not disappear harmfully. The limit is an explicit provisional expedition-economy guard.
operational.designNotes: Core V2 blocks and catalog summaries are preserved alongside this card. Components use the existing class focus where Core says F or M/F; this focus interpretation is provisional. Exact target eligibility, duration endpoints, saves where absent, concentration where unclear and anti-loop limits are provisional integration decisions. Core instantaneous creation is given a one-hour conjured-object lifetime and one active batch, plus once-per-recipient hydration, as explicit new test limits. Conference decision: hydration resets on elapsed24hours, independent of ability to complete a long rest.
operational.previousDraftDesignNotes: NEW provisional one-batch/1-hour anti-stockpile rule and legal-placement boundary. Source amount of up to 1 gallon of clean water is preserved.

preparedCompleteRecord.name: Polymorph

operational.targets: One physical creature you can perceive within 60 feet
operational.duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute; absolute checkpoint at casting timestamp +60 seconds, never extended by extra turns
operational.resolution: Choose one legal R4 spell-form profile and validate its space before payment. A willing target may waive its save. An unwilling target makes a Constitution save against your spell DC. On failure it transforms. At the end of each of its original regular turns, and once per numbered round after it suffers positive actual HP damage, it may repeat the save; success ends the transformation. Use the complete TRANSFORMATION_SPELL_PLAYTEST.md procedure and finite spell_form_profiles.json register. Preflight all targets, anatomy, space and access before committing Action/RP; commit ends your old concentration before counters or saves. A failed or countered new spell does not restore old concentration. An anatomy from another source is replaced only on actual success. No displaced form remains underneath.
operational.effect: Replace the target's current anatomy with the chosen R4 spell-form profile while preserving one body, current/max HP, temporary HP, Wounds, conditions, attributes, proficiency, identity, resources, initiative and condition clocks. The supplied form attack uses the original caster's current spell attack bonus and M. Equipment melds and is unavailable unless a separate anatomy-compatible passive bonus is certified. The target retains control of all decisions.
operational.scaling: No automatic profile, damage, target-count or duration scaling. Use only the bounded R4 spell-form register.
operational.limitations: No monster stat block, multiattack, class spellcasting, legendary power, new resource pool or second HP pool is gained. Speech, hands and movement come only from the selected profile. A willing target may spend its Action on its regular turn to end its own Polymorph. Actual 0 HP, death or Incapacitated after same-packet prevention resolves ends the spell without healing. Explicit transformation immunity and legendary defenses apply normally. Natural/form attacks do not automatically qualify for unrelated weapon-only features. The subject owns supplied natural-attack events; the original caster supplies attack statistics. These attacks are not spell casts or automatically caster spell-damage/kill triggers. A Druid cannot enter Shapeshift while a spell anatomy is active. Temporary lower-rank spells cannot replace higher-rank anatomy. Only a successful True Polymorph or an exact named exception can replace permanent True anatomy. Antimagic suppresses the same record while concentration and its absolute clock continue; True Polymorph can stabilize while suppressed. Suppression never frees an object-companion slot or resets gear. Creature-origin type tags remain unchanged; profile names confer no creature type. Every supplied attack has5-foot reach. Original anatomical abilities unavailable in the selected profile do not persist underneath it. A successful new transformation closes the old record and atomically restores/recaptures still-existing original gear; internal profile switches instead retain the same meld set and drop incompatible external gear. Mandatory reversion returns at the same anchor; blocked placement is referred to canonical geometry without automatic teleport or crushing damage. Original melded gear remains inaccessible under antimagic. A willing temporary creature-origin recipient can use its regular-turn rejection Action while suppressed if its root creature anatomy can act; object-origin identities gain no rejection right. No generic magical-attack bypass flag is granted.
operational.designNotes: PRESERVED: Polymorph identity, Transmutation Rank 4, exact class access, Action, 60 feet, V/S/F and base 7 RP. NEW: one-minute concentration, target/save/repeat-save procedure, R4 finite profile list, same-body state retention, caster-derived form attack, equipment/anatomy rules and zero-HP reversion.
operational.implementationStatus: REVIEWED / reference-VALIDATED operational-playtest draft

operational.targets: One eligible physical creature or one eligible discrete nonmagical unattended object within 120 feet
operational.duration: Concentration during a 1-minute shaping period; if maintained for the full minute, the transformation persists until dispelled without further concentration; absolute checkpoint at casting timestamp +60 seconds, never extended by extra turns
operational.resolution: Choose creature-to-creature, willing-creature-to-object, object-to-creature, or object-to-object before payment. Creature-to-creature may affect an unwilling target on a failed Constitution save; while shaping, that target repeats the save at each original regular end and once per numbered round after positive actual HP damage. Creature-to-object requires willingness. Objects make no save. If concentration survives the full shaping minute, the result becomes persistent until dispelled. Use the complete TRANSFORMATION_SPELL_PLAYTEST.md procedure and finite spell_form_profiles.json register. Preflight all targets, anatomy, space and access before committing Action/RP; commit ends your old concentration before counters or saves. A failed or countered new spell does not restore old concentration. An anatomy from another source is replaced only on actual success. No displaced form remains underneath.
operational.effect: Creature transformations retain one identity and one HP/durability history. Creature-to-creature uses any legal R4 or R9 spell-form profile. Creature-to-object creates one inert mundane object anatomy without healing or a new durability pool. Object-to-creature uses the object's existing structural HP as its one durability ledger and creates a controlled no-soul companion using an eligible non-humanoid R4/R9 profile and the caster's snapshotted spell statistics. Object-to-object changes only mundane form/material within the bounded utility restrictions.
operational.scaling: No automatic scaling. Permanent attack/DC values supplied by this spell snapshot the original caster's spell attack, spell DC and M when cast. Snapshot PB and source class as well. All True Polymorph supplied attack/DC values use this snapshot from casting, including shaping.
operational.limitations: No mode creates XP, loot, a soul, resurrection entitlement, valuable material, consumable stock, ammunition, currency, medicine, food or magical properties. Carried, worn, attuned, magical, artifact, structural-terrain and undefined-durability objects are ineligible. Object-origin creatures cannot receive ordinary HP healing as a means of repairing their source object. Only one active object-origin True Polymorph creature per caster is permitted. Such a creature shares the owner's companion Bonus Action/offensive budget and gains no independent turn/resources. Permanent True Polymorph does not end at 0 HP merely to restore the original form. Death/destruction remains real; later dispelling changes anatomy only and never heals, resurrects or recreates missing matter. The subject owns supplied natural-attack events; the original caster supplies attack statistics. These attacks are not spell casts or automatically caster spell-damage/kill triggers. A Druid cannot enter Shapeshift while a spell anatomy is active. Temporary lower-rank spells cannot replace higher-rank anatomy. Only a successful True Polymorph or an exact named exception can replace permanent True anatomy. Antimagic suppresses the same record while concentration and its absolute clock continue; True Polymorph can stabilize while suppressed. Suppression never frees an object-companion slot or resets gear. Creature-origin type tags remain unchanged; profile names confer no creature type. Every supplied attack has5-foot reach. Original anatomical abilities unavailable in the selected profile do not persist underneath it. A successful new transformation closes the old record and atomically restores/recaptures still-existing original gear; internal profile switches instead retain the same meld set and drop incompatible external gear. Mandatory reversion returns at the same anchor; blocked placement is referred to canonical geometry without automatic teleport or crushing damage. Original melded gear remains inaccessible under antimagic. A willing temporary creature-origin recipient can use its regular-turn rejection Action while suppressed if its root creature anatomy can act; object-origin identities gain no rejection right. No generic magical-attack bypass flag is granted. Object origin and earliest physical identity persist through every transformation chain. Object-origin creatures never gain a humanoid profile, soul, ordinary healing, resurrection or biological/class/rest resources. Use one actual structural HP ledger; structural0 destroys the object and ends its creature manifestation. Creature-origin object anatomy is actionless, not automatically Incapacitated. Allowed object templates are barrier/slab, ramp/wedge, open-container, static-furniture or simple-one-piece-tool; no actuated mechanism, magical or valuable output. Output size Tiny..Large and within one category of input; output mass cannot exceed recorded input or earliest origin mass; value cannot exceed original documented ceiling. Corpses/remains, magical/attuned/carried/worn/attended/structural objects and undefined structural durability are ineligible. An object-creature reserves its original caster slot on successful shaping; suppression/control change never frees it. At the60-second boundary finish damage, resolve due repeat save, then stabilize only surviving links. Replacing an active True object anatomy requires legal True replacement, not fresh nonmagical/unattended outside-object admission. Creature-origin people retain their CON save against unwilling creature-profile recasts and must consent to object-profile recasts. Returning them to creature anatomy grants no companion slot.
operational.designNotes: PRESERVED: True Polymorph identity, Rank 9, exact class access/schools, Action, 120 feet, V/S/F, base 26 RP, creature/object scope and meaningful until-dispelled permanence. NEW: one-minute shaping/stabilization procedure, save/agency rules, bounded form register, object eligibility/size/value rules, object-origin companion contract, one controlled-object-creature cap, durability conservation and destruction/dispel semantics.

preparedCompleteRecord.name: Faction Portal

operational.targets: One legal open local entrance space you perceive within 60 feet and line of effect, on suitable ground. Choose one exact canonical factionId with a recorded current reputation score above 0 and one specific known headquarters of that faction.
operational.duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute. In initiative, expires at the caster's tenth future regular-start marker after application; preserve the virtual phase through initiative changes, absence, death and planar travel. Outside initiative, expires 60 seconds after application, retaining that absolute deadline when entering initiative. An already-passed start does not count. Ends earlier if concentration ends.
operational.resolution: No roll. On successful casting create one visible, fixed, one-way doorway 5 feet wide and8 feet high. The destination is a known established public/default receiving point for the chosen headquarters, or, absent such a point, one specific known ordinary primary entrance/foyer. Identify it from personal experience or reliable public information; no existing portal infrastructure is needed. It may be on the same or another plane. Recheck each actual crossing against legal arrival space and exact teleport/planar blockers; failure leaves the crossing creature and belongings at the local entrance, with no split or deletion.
operational.effect:
Any creature that physically fits the entrance under ordinary anatomy/squeezing rules may use it; passengers need no positive reputation or faction membership. Entering costs 5 feet of ordinary movement, subject to ordinary movement-cost adjustments, and atomically transports that creature and its legally carried belongings to a legal unoccupied space at or adjacent to the chosen receiving point. Ordinary carried creatures may accompany it only within the carrier's actual anatomy, pound and Load capacity and with room for the whole arriving group; this does not create willing-target immunity against being actually carried. Choose the receiving point when casting and keep it fixed. At each crossing use the nearest legal space at/adjacent to that point that fits the whole group, with a fixed neutral board order for ties, never a tactical remote choice or search through barriers. If none exists, the crossing fails and the attempted movement remains spent. Ordinary approach movement can provoke opportunity attacks; the teleport transition itself cannot. Items carried through remain the same items with actual ownership, contents, conditions and provenance. Loose unattended objects do not independently activate transit: a creature must physically carry or legally handle them as part of its own crossing; thrown projectiles, remote pushes and spells cannot deliver goods through by themselves.

The doorway is opaque to sight and sound and supplies no line of effect through it. Attacks, spells, areas, projectiles and remote sensing do not pass. There is no exit doorway or automatic return route. Complete a currently resolving legal crossing atomically before closing/suppressing the doorway; expiry never bisects a body or cargo. Later crossings require the still-active doorway. Suppression makes it unusable without pausing its endpoint. It has no physical HP, support or barrier body; when inactive there is no active transit surface. One portal per caster; a successful replacement closes the old one. Current positive reputation is checked as a creation gate at cast start and resolution, not a continuing passenger credential; a later standing change does not itself close a created portal.
operational.scaling: None.
operational.limitations: Use the actual canonical reputation record: positive means above 0, normally+1 through+3 under REPUTATION.md; missing/0/negative standing fails the gate. This card does not replace that scale with the historical Gameplay Loop's -5..+5 scale. No faction membership, Seal invocation permission, headquarters infrastructure or automatic entry authorization is added. If there are several HQs, select exactly one known site; no hidden vault, secret room, unknown HQ, location search or knowledge report. The far endpoint needs no originating line of sight/effect and has no geographic range ceiling, but actual wards and legal placement still apply. A headquarters that ceases to exist or belong to the faction cannot receive new crossings; a purely clerical name change does not move the chosen physical point. Failed crossings reveal no cause beyond failure, although ordinary observers may draw inferences. The spell can bypass a geographic route leg and deliver people to Haven when that actual HQ is there. It never automatically completes Extraction, advances or resets the Opening clock, settles cargo claims, removes contamination, changes ownership/reputation, grants credentials, ignores guards/laws/taxes or refunds cast costs. No free actions, additional capacity, object duplication or attacker path across planes. A successful replacement has its own endpoint; stale cleanup cannot end the new application. A countered cast creates no replacement, although its concentration transition has already occurred. Actual class access, rank, preparation, V/S/F components, casting costs, Dissonance/Refrain, class hooks, concentration transitions and counter windows follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Costs and beginning hooks commit before interruption, with no refunds or restoration of prior concentration. Direct target selection and local creation require the printed line of effect; expressly remote teleport destinations use their own printed rules. No generic upcast or unstated scaling.
operational.designNotes: PRESERVED: Action/60 feet/V,S,F, doorway to a faction headquarters with positive reputation, actual planar travel supported by Planar tag. CONFLICT RULING: Core Instantaneous metadata becomes NEW 1 minute concentration for a usable doorway. NEW: known ordinary receiving-site procedure, fixed one-way 5 x 8 ft entrance, local 5 foot movement cost, whole-group atomic arrival, opaque transport-only interface, any-passenger use, no later reputation tether and exact destination legality. Canon positive predicate is retained without silently changing the reputation scale; route bypass remains possible while actual settlement procedures persist.
operational.implementationStatus: REVIEWED authored operational-playtest manuscript; runtime, travel-system implementation, numerical balance and whole-game validation pending

operational.targets: One uniquely designated fixed point on your plane within 1 mile; only you receive the selected remote sense.
operational.duration: 1 minute, no concentration. In initiative, expires at the caster's tenth future regular-start marker after application; outside initiative, expires 60 elapsed seconds after application. Preserve the virtual phase or absolute deadline through initiative changes, absence, death and planar travel. An already-passed start never counts.
operational.resolution: No roll. Choose Sight or Hearing when casting; this mode cannot change during the application. Designate the point through direct perception, prior personal knowledge, a reliable map/description, or a precise relative position from a known reference. A uniquely specified unseen point qualifies; an unspecified hidden room does not. No originating sight or line of effect to the point is required. A point inside solid matter is invalid and yields no feed.
operational.effect: Sight lets you perceive from that point in all directions with ordinary local lighting, visibility, cover and obscurity; it grants no darkvision, true sight, wall vision or borrowed creature senses. Hearing follows ordinary local sound paths, barriers, silence, distances and volumes. Your normal local senses continue simultaneously. Blindness suppresses remote Sight and Deafened suppresses remote Hearing while applicable. Maintain the same-plane, 5,280-foot tether between you and the point. Leaving that tether suppresses the feed without ending or pausing the duration; returning restores only current information. Actual subject/area Divination protections withhold protected information within their scope, leaving independently readable information available.
operational.scaling: None. No automatic increase in range, duration, targets, damage or information.
operational.limitations: One active Clairvoyance point per caster; a successful new cast replaces the old point. The point remains at its chosen location and cannot move, follow a creature or surface, or search through rooms; all-direction sight permits looking from that one point, not translating it. It is a nonphysical ongoing magical effect without HP, affected only by another effect with actual permission to detect, suppress or end it. Suppression pauses no clock and records no backlog. No remote attacks, interaction, spellcasting origin, line of effect for another power, translation, identity authentication, persistent recording object or replay is granted. A dark/silent/blocked feed does not diagnose its cause. A successful replacement owns its own endpoint; stale cleanup cannot remove it. A failed or countered cast creates no replacement. Actual class access, repertoire, V/S/F components, costs, Dissonance/Refrain, beginning hooks, concentration transitions and interruption follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Committed costs are not refunded by a failed or countered effect, and prior concentration is not restored. Only explicit remote-destination or concealment exceptions override ordinary originating line of effect. Information protections apply to their actual subject and source scope; hidden but unprotected facts remain valid, and undefined facts are not invented. No automatic scaling or upcast.

NEW: one minute without concentration replaces Instantaneous metadata; fixed uniquely designated point, immutable mode, same-plane tether and sensory limits. currentSourceCatalogRecord.name: Clairvoyance

operational.targets: One uniquely designated fixed point on your plane within 1 mile; only you receive the selected remote sense.
operational.duration: 1 minute, no concentration. In initiative, expires at the caster's tenth future regular-start marker after application; outside initiative, expires 60 elapsed seconds after application. Preserve the virtual phase or absolute deadline through initiative changes, absence, death and planar travel. An already-passed start never counts.
operational.resolution: No roll. Choose Sight or Hearing when casting; this mode cannot change during the application. Designate the point through direct perception, prior personal knowledge, a reliable map/description, or a precise relative position from a known reference. A uniquely specified unseen point qualifies; an unspecified hidden room does not. No originating sight or line of effect to the point is required. A point inside solid matter is invalid and yields no feed.
operational.effect: Sight lets you perceive from that point in all directions with ordinary local lighting, visibility, cover and obscurity; it grants no darkvision, true sight, wall vision or borrowed creature senses. Hearing follows ordinary local sound paths, barriers, silence, distances and volumes. Your normal local senses continue simultaneously. Blindness suppresses remote Sight and Deafened suppresses remote Hearing while applicable. Maintain the same-plane, 5,280-foot tether between you and the point. Leaving that tether suppresses the feed without ending or pausing the duration; returning restores only current information. Actual subject/area Divination protections withhold protected information within their scope, leaving independently readable information available.
operational.scaling: None. No automatic increase in range, duration, targets, damage or information.
operational.limitations: One active Clairvoyance point per caster; a successful new cast replaces the old point. The point remains at its chosen location and cannot move, follow a creature or surface, or search through rooms; all-direction sight permits looking from that one point, not translating it. It is a nonphysical ongoing magical effect without HP, affected only by another effect with actual permission to detect, suppress or end it. Suppression pauses no clock and records no backlog. No remote attacks, interaction, spellcasting origin, line of effect for another power, translation, identity authentication, persistent recording object or replay is granted. A dark/silent/blocked feed does not diagnose its cause. A successful replacement owns its own endpoint; stale cleanup cannot remove it. A failed or countered cast creates no replacement. Actual class access, repertoire, V/S/F components, costs, Dissonance/Refrain, beginning hooks, concentration transitions and interruption follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Committed costs are not refunded by a failed or countered effect, and prior concentration is not restored. Only explicit remote-destination or concealment exceptions override ordinary originating line of effect. Information protections apply to their actual subject and source scope; hidden but unprotected facts remain valid, and undefined facts are not invented. No automatic scaling or upcast.
operational.designNotes: PRESERVED: Action/V,S,F and seeing OR hearing a location within one mile. CONFLICT RULING: explicit one-mile range controls over raw 30 feet. NEW: one minute without concentration replaces Instantaneous metadata; fixed uniquely designated point, immutable mode, same-plane tether and sensory limits. Exact-card completion adds one active point per caster, consistent with Clairaudience (Lesser), without narrowing the conference’s unvisited-point designation.
operational.implementationStatus: REVIEWED authored operational PLAYTEST manuscript; runtime, numerical balance and broader Divination/information-system validation pending

preparedCompleteRecord.name: True Sight (Lesser)

operational.targets: Self; creatures within 30 feet on your plane.
operational.duration: 1 minute, no concentration. In initiative, expires at the caster's tenth future regular-start marker after application; outside initiative, expires 60 elapsed seconds after application. Preserve the virtual phase or absolute deadline through initiative changes, absence, death and planar travel. An already-passed start never counts.
operational.resolution: No roll or additional scanning Action. For the duration you can actually see creatures in the area despite Invisible, Hidden or ordinary non-solid visual obscurity, including darkness, smoke, mist and foliage.
operational.effect: This magical sight reveals the creature itself sufficiently for ordinary sight-dependent targeting. It ends Hidden from you and removes Invisible’s own unseen attack modifiers for you under the current Core known-position exception. Solid opaque barriers and total cover still block the view. Blindness or another effect expressly preventing your sight still applies. Other cover and independent obstructions retain whatever effect this sight does not actually overcome. Protection from Scrying can withhold new Divination-derived sight of its protected creature, but does not conceal a creature your ordinary senses can already see.
operational.scaling: None. No automatic increase in targets, range, duration, uses or information.
operational.limitations: Only you gain this sense. You may communicate what you perceive through ordinary means; allies gain neither magical sight nor automatic identification. It supplies no true-form/disguise detection, Ethereal sight, alignment, hidden-object search, general illusion revelation or creature statistics. Once a position has been learned, spell expiry does not erase that knowledge or automatically reestablish Hidden; later actual hiding and ordinary sensory changes use the existing rules. One active True Sight (Lesser) per caster; successful recasting replaces it. A successful replacement owns its new endpoint; stale cleanup cannot remove it. A failed or countered cast creates no replacement, although an applicable concentration transition has already happened. Actual class access, repertoire, V/S/F components, costs, Dissonance/Refrain, beginning hooks, concentration transitions and interruption follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Costs commit before the counter window without refunds or restoration of prior concentration. Explicit remote-destination/concealment exceptions override ordinary originating line of effect only as printed. Specific information protections apply to their actual subject and generating-source scope; hidden but unprotected facts are valid information, and missing facts are never invented. No automatic scaling or upcast.
operational.designNotes: PRESERVED: Action/V,S,F, one-minute sight of invisible/hidden creatures without concentration. CONFLICT RULING: raw 30-foot metadata becomes a 30-foot sensing radius for a Self beneficiary. NEW: exact non-solid-obscurity/solid-cover boundary, passive sight and observer-specific consequences.

preparedCompleteRecord.name: Counterspell

operational.activation: Reaction — when another creature you can perceive within range and line of effect begins casting a spell, after its casting costs and cadence are committed but before its effect resolves
operational.targets: One pending spell cast by the triggering creature. The spell needs an actual recorded rank; the Director may know that rank without revealing it to you.
operational.duration: Instantaneous
operational.resolution: make a spellcasting-ability check using the actual ability for the class through which you cast Counterspell, adding PB once, against DC 10 + twice the triggering spell's actual rank (rank 0 contributes 0). Use CORE_RESOLUTION_PLAYTEST.md's fixed-DC task degrees and natural shifts: at least DC+10 Critical Success, at least DC Success, at most DC-10 Critical Failure, otherwise Failure; natural 20 improves one degree and natural 1 worsens one. Collapse both upper degrees to success and both lower degrees to failure; invent no additional critical effect. This is not a spell attack or saving throw.
operational.effect: Success negates the selected pending spell after its costs were committed; failure lets it continue. Every interruptible cast first commits its RP/material/other costs, components, concentration transition, Dissonance/Refrain and exact beginning/casting hooks once, then opens the interruption window. A surviving cast later resolves its effect and outcome-dependent hooks. Negation gives no refund, no successful-effect trigger and no restoration of old concentration. Counterspell is itself a spell and can be countered. Resolve nested counters last-in, first-out; if a counter is negated, the earlier pending spell resumes without paying or casting again. Resuming a parent never rewrites the later nested cast's Refrain/Dissonance history.
operational.scaling: None. No automatic success against lower ranks and no generic upcast.
operational.limitations: One attempt per creature against a particular pending cast, shared across ordinary, Wizard, Mage and other same-named Counterspell sources. An exact source that expressly grants an additional Counterspell attempt against the same pending cast overrides this default; merely granting another Reaction does not. preparedCompleteRecord.name: Resonance Anchor

operational.targets: One perceptible ongoing magical effect with a discrete spatial origin/area within range and line of effect, created by you or explicitly permitted for anchoring by its current source owner/controller. It cannot be Resonance Anchor, an effect permanently attached to a creature/carried object, or an effect currently dependent on your own existing concentration.
operational.duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute. If cast in initiative, expires at the caster's tenth future regular-start marker; preserve that virtual marker through order changes or departure. If cast outside initiative, expires 60 seconds after application; entering initiative preserves that absolute deadline. An already-passed start does not count. Ends earlier if concentration ends. Also ends when the anchored target effect ends.
operational.resolution: Automatic after legal casting. Check the own-concentration exclusion before committing this cast: it forbids targeting an effect that beginning Anchor would itself end.
operational.effect: Fix the selected effect's spatial origin in its current position; a movable/recenterable zone loses that relocation permission while anchored. Ordinary dispelling cannot end the target, including otherwise eligible Dispel Minor, Dispel Resonance, Dispel Magic (Lesser) or Dispel Magic. Anchor itself remains normally dispellable at its own actual rank. REVIEWED CLARIFICATION: anchoring fixes location, not the target's unrelated source-authorized evolution of radius, shape or nonspatial effects; it neither freezes nor manufactures those source changes.
operational.scaling: None.
operational.limitations: Cannot target itself or another Resonance Anchor. No duration extension, replacement of the target's concentration, use/cost reset, revival, restored pulse, frozen expiry or retroactive Counterspell protection. The target can still end by its own concentration, duration, destruction, source conditions, special removal or explicit anchor-bypassing effect. Its original owner/controller can still exercise a printed ending permission. Another caster's anchored concentration spell still requires that caster's concentration. No class engine or full Time Loop implementation is granted. Apply SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md for actual class access and repertoire, costs before resolution, components, concentration, Dissonance/Refrain and exact source cadence. No automatic scaling or generic upcast.
operational.designNotes: PRESERVED: Action, 60 feet, V/S/F, fixing a magical effect and preventing ordinary dispel. NEW CONFLICT RULING: concentration 1 minute replaces Instantaneous metadata. NEW: spatial eligibility/controller permission, own-concentration exclusion, Anchor's removability and no mutual anchoring. Location remains fixed while otherwise source-authorized size/shape evolution continues.

preparedCompleteRecord.name: Resonance Well

operational.targets: One fixed point you can perceive within range and line of effect for a nonphysical pool of resonance.
operational.duration: If applied in initiative, expires at the caster's tenth future regular-start marker after application; preserve that virtual phase through initiative changes, absence or death. Outside initiative, expires 60 seconds after application; retain that absolute deadline on entering initiative. An already-passed start never counts. Ends earlier if the spell is ended or a later successful allowed application replaces it.
operational.resolution: Before activation/payment confirm the caster's unused character-wide Resonance Well creation use. Spend it at legal cast start before the Counterspell window. On successful resolution roll 1d4 exactly once to establish the total RP reserve. This amount belongs to the entire Well, not each recipient.
operational.effect: One creation use per character across classes/copies refreshes only at that character's actual beneficial completed long rest. A countered cast spends the use and creates no Well. A creature with an actual RP pool, including the caster, can spend an Action within 5 feet and line of effect to draw. Verify its unused character-wide Resonance Well receipt use since its own last beneficial completed long rest and a positive remaining reserve. At draw start choose a positive amount no greater than that reserve, spend the recipient use and Action, and subtract that amount immediately. At resolution restore the chosen amount, capped at actual RP maximum. Over-cap recovery is wasted; a full recipient can deliberately spend a positive draw and recover 0. Zero draw is illegal. A preventing interrupt refunds nothing.
operational.scaling: None.
operational.limitations: One Well per caster. Receipt use is shared across all Wells/casters/classes and refreshes only at the recipient's own beneficial long rest; creation and receipt are separate records, including when caster draws from their own Well. Kindle and Mod Rod keep their separate named ledgers: Well neither resets nor shares them. At reserve 0 the Well is inert until its endpoint. Re-entry, suppression, replacement, dispelling, copying or recovery prevention never rerolls/refills the reserve or restores spent uses. Suppression prevents drawing while applicable and does not pause duration; if drawing was already committed, a subsequent actual prevention leaves its amount/use spent. This fixed nonphysical resonance cannot be carried as water, harvested, sold, used as Supply, drawn at range or treated as a pooled RP maximum. It provides no physical support, hazard or damage despite the historical Damage tag. A successful new application owns its own endpoint; stale cleanup of a prior application cannot end its replacement. A countered cast creates no replacement. Starting concentration still ends the caster's incompatible prior concentration before interruption. Known/prepared access, actual class rank/level, V/S/F components, line of effect, costs, concentration transitions, Dissonance/Refrain, class hooks and interruption follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Total cover blocks originating line of effect and direct targeting. No generic upcast or unstated scaling.
operational.designNotes: PRESERVED: Action/30 feet/V/S/F and a pool from which allies draw 1d4 RP. CONFLICT RULING: finite 1-minute nonconcentration pool replaces Instantaneous metadata; Damage tag grants no unprinted damage. NEW: one rolled total reserve, explicit Action/5-foot draw, caster inclusion, positive committed withdrawals and distinct creation/receipt limits per beneficial long rest. Source supplied no daily limit; both anti-farm limits are explicitly provisional additions, not recovered canon.

operational.duration: If applied in initiative, expires at the caster's tenth future regular-start marker after application; preserve that virtual phase through initiative changes, absence or death. Outside initiative, expires 60 seconds after application; retain that absolute deadline on entering initiative. An already-passed start never counts. Ends earlier if the spell is ended or a later successful allowed application replaces it.
operational.resolution: Before activation/payment confirm the caster's unused character-wide Resonance Well creation use. Spend it at legal cast start before the Counterspell window. On successful resolution roll 1d4 exactly once to establish the total RP reserve. This amount belongs to the entire Well, not each recipient.
operational.effect: One creation use per character across classes/copies refreshes only at that character's actual beneficial completed long rest. A countered cast spends the use and creates no Well. A creature with an actual RP pool, including the caster, can spend an Action within 5 feet and line of effect to draw. Verify its unused character-wide Resonance Well receipt use since its own last beneficial completed long rest and a positive remaining reserve. At draw start choose a positive amount no greater than that reserve, spend the recipient use and Action, and subtract that amount immediately. At resolution restore the chosen amount, capped at actual RP maximum. Over-cap recovery is wasted; a full recipient can deliberately spend a positive draw and recover 0. Zero draw is illegal. A preventing interrupt refunds nothing.
operational.scaling: None.
operational.limitations: One Well per caster. Receipt use is shared across all Wells/casters/classes and refreshes only at the recipient's own beneficial long rest; creation and receipt are separate records, including when caster draws from their own Well. Kindle and Mod Rod keep their separate named ledgers: Well neither resets nor shares them. At reserve 0 the Well is inert until its endpoint. Re-entry, suppression, replacement, dispelling, copying or recovery prevention never rerolls/refills the reserve or restores spent uses. Suppression prevents drawing while applicable and does not pause duration; if drawing was already committed, a subsequent actual prevention leaves its amount/use spent. This fixed nonphysical resonance cannot be carried as water, harvested, sold, used as Supply, drawn at range or treated as a pooled RP maximum. It provides no physical support, hazard or damage despite the historical Damage tag. A successful new application owns its own endpoint; stale cleanup of a prior application cannot end its replacement. A countered cast creates no replacement. Starting concentration still ends the caster's incompatible prior concentration before interruption. Known/prepared access, actual class rank/level, V/S/F components, line of effect, costs, concentration transitions, Dissonance/Refrain, class hooks and interruption follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Total cover blocks originating line of effect and direct targeting. No generic upcast or unstated scaling.
operational.designNotes: PRESERVED: Action/30 feet/V/S/F and a pool from which allies draw 1d4 RP. CONFLICT RULING: finite 1-minute nonconcentration pool replaces Instantaneous metadata; Damage tag grants no unprinted damage. NEW: one rolled total reserve, explicit Action/5-foot draw, caster inclusion, positive committed withdrawals and distinct creation/receipt limits per beneficial long rest. Source supplied no daily limit; both anti-farm limits are explicitly provisional additions, not recovered canon.
operational.implementationStatus: REVIEWED authored operational-playtest manuscript; runtime, CR certification and numerical balance pending

preparedCompleteRecord.name: Resonance Conduit

operational.targets: Two distinct willing creatures with actual RP pools, each perceived within 60 feet and line of effect. You may be one participant. Each participant must be free of another active Resonance Conduit.
operational.duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute. In initiative, expires at the caster's tenth future regular-start marker after application; preserve the virtual phase through initiative changes, absence, death and planar travel. Outside initiative, expires 60 seconds after application, retaining that absolute deadline when entering initiative. An already-passed start does not count. Ends earlier with concentration or either participant willingly ending the link.
operational.resolution: Automatic link creation, no RP transfer from the casting itself. Either participant may spend an Action to transfer a positive integer of existing RP to the other while both are on the same plane, within 60 feet of one another and have line of effect. At transfer start the recipient must accept; choose an amount no greater than donor currentRP or recipient currently missingRP. Commit the Action and immediately deduct that amount from the donor. At resolution credit the same amount, capped at recipient actual maximumRP; any newly excess amount is lost.
operational.effect: The two creatures retain separate RP pools and maxima. Deducted pendingRP is not spendable by either party and cannot be committed again; only a completed credit enters the recipient's pool. At resolution the link and recipient acceptance must still exist and same-plane/range/line-of-effect gates must still hold. If an exact interrupt or loss of these conditions prevents the transfer after commitment, its RP and Action are not refunded. Ordinary movement outside the transfer gate suspends permission without ending the link or pausing duration; returning restores only future permission. Either participant may voluntarily end the whole link without an Action, including before agreeing to a new conduit; ending one participant's link releases both, but never reverses completed or committed transfers. The caster can maintain only one conduit and each participant can belong to only one at a time.
operational.scaling: None.
operational.limitations: The original cast pays its own 5 RP base cost and applicable surcharges before the link exists; future transfer cannot finance it retroactively. Transferring is not casting, recovery from rest or creation of RP. Casting/Dissonance/Refrain/resource-generation hooks do not apply unless an exact feature expressly names Conduit transfer. No joint maximum, discounts on the transfer amount, overflow store, negative balance, duplicate credits, borrowed casting rights, simultaneous double spending, future recovery, HP, charges or materials. Copies cannot duplicate transfers or create spendable RP. No daily limit is added; named recovery ledgers, Dissonance, Refrain, actions and clocks remain unchanged. Suppression prevents transfer while applicable without pausing the endpoint; it never refunds a committed transfer. Renewed consent alone cannot revive an ended application. A later legal casting may create a new Resonance Conduit normally, paying all costs and establishing a new application and endpoint. A successful replacement has its own endpoint; stale cleanup cannot end the new application. A countered cast creates no replacement, although its concentration transition has already occurred. Actual class access, rank, preparation, V/S/F components, casting costs, Dissonance/Refrain, class hooks, concentration transitions and counter windows follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Costs and beginning hooks commit before interruption, with no refunds or restoration of prior concentration. Direct target selection and local creation require the printed line of effect; expressly remote teleport destinations use their own printed rules. No generic upcast or unstated scaling.
operational.designNotes: PRESERVED: Action/60 feet/V,S,F and RP sharing between allies. CONFLICT RULING: Core Instantaneous metadata becomes a NEW finite 1 minute concentration permission rather than an indefinite shared pool. NEW: two participants/one link each, Action transfer, actual-pool conservation,60 foot same-plane/line-of-effect gate, commitment/no-refund timing, current-cap clipping and explicit participant withdrawal.
operational.implementationStatus: REVIEWED authored operational-playtest manuscript; runtime, travel-system implementation, numerical balance and whole-game validation pending

preparedCompleteRecord.name: Find Familiar

operational.targets: One unoccupied space you can perceive within range; summons one Small spirit familiar
operational.duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
operational.resolution: No initial roll. The familiar's commanded attack uses your spell attack bonus.
operational.effect: Summon one Small spirit familiar using the shared standard companion profile: AC 12+floor(PB/2), HP equal to 2 times your class level, Speed 30 feet, saves equal to your PB, other checks +0, and one melee or ranged attack with 5-foot reach or 30-foot range using your spell attack bonus and dealing S d6 damage of bludgeoning, piercing or slashing damage (choose one type and melee or ranged mode on casting; keep them fixed for that summon). It acts immediately after you. While within 60 feet and able to perceive your command, your Bonus Action can command it to move and make its one attack or take another basic action; without a command it may move and Dodge.
operational.scaling: Uses the shared companion profile: AC increases with PB, HP equals 2×class level, and attack damage is S d6 at class levels 1/5/11/17.
operational.limitations: All companions you own share one Bonus Action command and one damaging companion action total per round. The familiar gains no unstated flight, invisibility, telepathy, special senses, resistances, immunities, spell delivery, independent spellcasting, Help-based automatic advantage, loot, wages, corpse, resource generation, death trigger, or free resummon benefit. It disappears at 0 HP or when concentration ends. Recasting replaces your prior familiar from this spell. Ranked casting causes normal Dissonance and Refrain.
operational.designNotes: Core V2 Action, 30-foot range, concentration up to 1 minute, and V/S/F components are retained. The source provides no specific familiar statistics, so the existing shared standard-companion profile is used rather than importing another game's familiar block. Command range/perception and anti-loop limits follow the current playtest companion interface.

earlierUnadoptedCounterpartProposals.procedure: Action; range 60 feet; V/S/F. NEW: create a fixed 60-foot-radius sphere centered on a perceived point within range and line of effect, with concentration up to one minute. It prevents an actual teleportation or planar-transition transaction when any transported body’s origin or destination footprint intersects the area. Cargo travels with its actual body; an object transported independently uses its own endpoints. Do not test an imaginary path between two outside endpoints. Ordinary travel through the area remains possible. The rule applies to willing, hostile and self transport using established location records; it creates no destination or plane. A portal can remain present, but transit using a blocked endpoint cannot complete. A known obstruction fails preflight before payment; hidden obstruction or a field established after commitment can defeat a paid transit, leaving the entire transaction at its origin. Atomic group travel fails together, without splitting bodies or inventory. Ending or suppressing the field allows future otherwise legal transactions but does not retry or refund past attempts. The field does not suppress summons, images, mundane movement, physical forced displacement, spells generally, or effects merely because they once crossed space. There is no save or physical cage. An explicit source exception can bypass only the prevention it actually names.

completeCurrentEnvelope.protectedInterfaceOriginal: Once per turn, spending 2 or more Conviction on a Rite or Invocation vents 1 Dissonance; prayer changes cadence instead of bypassing Resonance.
engine: PROVISIONAL PLAYTEST CONTRACT. Wisdom is the Cleric class ability. S = 1/2/3/4 at Cleric levels 1/5/11/17. M = max(1, Wisdom modifier) unless a feature explicitly substitutes another ability. Cleric technique attack = d20 + normal character proficiency bonus + Wisdom modifier. Cleric technique save DC = 8 + normal character proficiency bonus + Wisdom modifier.

Conviction is separate from Resonance Points. Base Conviction maximum is 3, automatically becoming 5 at Cleric 9; after a long rest you begin at your current maximum. A completed short rest restores 1 spent Conviction, to the maximum. A completed long rest restores all Conviction. Conviction Pool raises the maximum by 2. Conviction persists between encounters; simply declaring prayer, repeating a Rite, or performing harmless actions outside a real encounter never generates Conviction.

Only explicit features generate Conviction. Sacred Chant, Sermon of Purpose, Doctrine Shield, Dark Conviction and other printed cards are valid generators. A feature cannot generate more Conviction than its text permits, and Conviction can never exceed the current maximum. Summoned creatures, friendly creatures, trivial creatures, repeated corpse manipulation and staged out-of-combat actions cannot be used to farm Conviction.

Cleric techniques use only their printed RP and Conviction costs. All RP is paid from the Cleric's Core Systems V 2 Resonance Point pool. A Cleric technique is not automatically an ordinary spell-rank cast and does not receive Overcast, spell-slot, cost-discount or spell-proc benefits unless a feature explicitly says otherwise. Ordinary spells continue to use Core V 2 spellcasting rules.

Protected Dissonance interaction: once on each of your regular turns, when you spend at least 2 Conviction on a Rite or Invocation, reduce Dissonance by 1, minimum 0. The expenditure must actually occur; waived Conviction costs do not vent Dissonance. A single feature expenditure vents at most once even if it spends more than 2 Conviction. No Cleric card automatically adds Dissonance unless explicitly written.

One concentration effect may be maintained at a time. Starting another concentration effect immediately ends the previous one. Damage uses the current Core Systems concentration rule; for this pilot, if a division requires rounding, half damage is rounded down. Sustained Cleric effects use their printed maintenance cost and Bonus Action. A control effect that persists for multiple pulses or rounds gives the target a new save at each printed pulse or at the end of each affected turn as stated.

Round recharge counters are set after resolution and decrease once at the start of the Cleric's regular initiative turn, even if the Cleric cannot act. Extra Actions and extra turns do not create extra recharge ticks. Outside initiative, each uninterrupted 6 seconds counts as one recharge tick. Only a positive counter may be reset or shortened, and a named ability can receive at most one reset or shortening per round.

Healing cannot exceed maximum HP, does not remove Wounds, and does not restore a dead creature unless a card explicitly says it resurrects. No Cleric feature provides unlimited permanent HP or resource restoration outside encounters. Temporary HP does not stack with itself; use the higher value. Resurrection and corpse-based effects have explicit use limits and cannot generate repeatable corpses, XP, loot or Conviction.

Invocation Attunement is gained automatically at Cleric level 2. Choose exactly one Invocation Path: Radiance, Judgment, Renewal, Flame, Veil or Echoes. Only the selected path bonus becomes active. Divine Invocation uses the mode belonging to that selected path unless another feature explicitly permits a different mode. Changing Invocation Path requires a future explicit retraining rule; this draft provides none.

PROPOSED ACQUISITION FOR PLAYTEST. Cleric 1: gain the Divine Favor engine and choose 4 Base cards, at least 2 Active. Cleric 2: automatically gain Invocation Attunement and the selected Invocation Path bonus, then choose 2 additional Base cards. Cleric 3: enter Bishop and choose 2 Arch cards, at least 1 Active. Levels 4-8 each grant one eligible Base/Arch choice, respecting each card's minimum class level. Level 9 grants one eligible Arch choice plus Bishop's Mandate automatically. Level 10 choose Saint, Priest or Cultist and gain 2 Hero choices from that path. Levels 12, 14, 16 and 18 each grant one additional Hero choice; levels 11, 13, 15, 17 and 19 grant one eligible unselected Base/Arch choice. The chosen Hero Finale is automatic at Cleric 20. ASI/feat milestones remain separate and do not consume these choices.

All acquisition gates use Cleric class level, not total character level. Proficiency bonus still follows normal total-character-level rules. A multiclass character cannot use non-Cleric levels to unlock Bishop, Hero, Invocation or Finale features. Divine commands, visions and social abilities can influence actions only to the extent their exact mechanical text states; no Cleric feature can force a player character to adopt, abandon or profess a belief.

Capacity clarification: the automatic level 9 Conviction increase is a new draft completion so every Hero can pay its 5-Conviction Finale without buying Conviction Pool. Conviction Pool adds 2 at any level, yielding 5 early or 7 from 9. It never fills gained capacity immediately.
workedExample: Cleric 5 example: Wisdom 16 gives M=3, PB=3, S=2. Assume the Core V 2 sheet gives this test Cleric 12 RP. The Cleric knows Conviction Pool, so maximum Conviction is 5, begins the encounter at Conviction 5, Dissonance 3, and selected Judgment at level 2.

Turn 1: Divine Smite costs 1 Conviction, so Conviction 5→4 and RP remains 12. On a hit it deals 2d8+3 radiant damage. Judgment automatically marks the target Judged for 2 rounds, giving it -1 AC. Spending only 1 Conviction does not vent Dissonance.

Turn 2: Divine Invocation costs 2 Conviction and 3 RP, so Conviction 4→2 and RP 12→9. Because an Invocation spent at least 2 Conviction, Dissonance vents once, 3→2. Using Judgment mode, a failed Wisdom save causes the printed 3d8 radiant effect and refreshes Judged.

Turn 3: Healing Rite costs 2 RP, so RP 9→7. It restores 2d8+3 HP to one living ally. It spends no Conviction, so Conviction remains 2 and Dissonance remains 2. If the ally stood in the Cleric's Consecrate zone and Consecrated Ground was known, the target would also regain the printed S=2 bonus HP.
Turn 4: Sacred Chant costs 1 RP to start, so RP 7→6. Its first pulse occurs, but generates no Conviction yet. The Cleric concentrates on the Chant. Conviction stays 2.

Turn 5: The Cleric maintains Sacred Chant with a Bonus Action. Because Sermon of Purpose is known, the second pulse generates 1 Conviction, 2→3. The Cleric then uses Divine Smite as the normal Action, spending 1 Conviction, 3→2. RP remains 6 and Dissonance remains 2 because no single Rite or Invocation expenditure of at least 2 Conviction occurred this turn.
balanceQuestions: Does a 3-point base Conviction cap, or 5 with Conviction Pool, create meaningful expenditure choices without making Sacred Chant mandatory in every encounter?
Do Bishop's Mandate, Miraculous Channel and the six Invocation modes create excessive burst or action compression when combined, especially at levels 7-10?

Across Saint, Priest and Cultist, are healing, control, resurrection and Conviction regeneration sufficiently bounded across multiple encounters without making ordinary Core V2 spellcasting irrelevant?

cards.name: Conviction Pool
cards.effect: Conviction Pool. Tags: conviction, passive. Increase your Conviction maximum by 2. This changes only the maximum; it does not immediately restore spent Conviction when acquired during play. A long rest restores Conviction to the new maximum.

source.originalText: Conviction Pool: +2 max Conviction cap.

cards.name: Consecrated Ground
cards.effect: Consecrated Ground. Tags: rite, healing, passive. Whenever one of your healing Rites restores HP to a living creature standing in terrain created by your Consecrate feature, that creature regains S additional HP. Apply this once per creature per Rite pulse; it is flat healing and is not itself another healing trigger.

source.originalText: Consecrated Ground: Healing allies on terrain you sanctify (via Rite) heals for +10%.

cards.name: Judging Light
cards.effect: Judging Light. Tags: smite, passive. When your Divine Smite damages a creature currently affected by a Cursed or Weakened condition, add S d4 radiant damage to that Smite. Roll these dice once as part of the Smite; they do not create a second hit or trigger.

source.originalText: Judging Light: Smite deals +20% bonus damage to enemies afflicted by Cursed or Weakened effects.

cards.name: Fervent Ritualist
cards.effect: Fervent Ritualist. Tags: rite, ritual, passive. When a Rite with a Ritual activation normally requires at least 10 minutes, reduce its required time by 1 minute for each full 10 minutes of its printed casting time. This never reduces a Ritual below 1 minute and does not alter Action, Bonus Action or Reaction Rites.

source.originalText: Fervent Ritualist: +10% faster channel speed on all Rites.

cards.name: Invocation Attunement
cards.effect: Invocation Attunement. Tags: invocation, core. At Cleric level 2 choose exactly one Invocation Path: Radiance, Judgment, Renewal, Flame, Veil or Echoes. You automatically gain that path's listed bonus. Divine Invocation thereafter uses that path's mode unless another feature explicitly overrides it.

source.originalText: Invocation Attunement: Choose one Invocation Path (see below); gain a permanent passive tied to it.

cards.name: Radiance
cards.frequency: Automatic only if Radiance was selected
cards.effect: Invocation Path — Radiance. Tags: invocation, radiance, healing. Once on each of your turns when one of your Rites restores HP to at least one living creature, choose one creature healed by that Rite. It regains S additional HP and may immediately end either Frightened or Poisoned on itself.

source.originalText: Radiance: +10% healing power and heals cleanse minor conditions.

cards.name: Judgment
cards.frequency: Automatic only if Judgment was selected
cards.effect: Invocation Path — Judgment. Tags: invocation, judgment, smite. When your Divine Smite deals damage to a creature, mark it Judged for 2 rounds. A Judged creature has -1 AC. Further applications refresh the duration but do not increase the AC penalty.

source.originalText: Judgment: Smites mark enemies with Judged for 2 rounds, reducing their AC by 1.

cards.name: Renewal
cards.frequency: Automatic only if Renewal was selected
cards.effect: Invocation Path — Renewal. Tags: invocation, renewal, healing, rite. Once per use of a healing Rite, choose one creature that actually regained HP from it. That creature also restores 5 Stamina, not exceeding its Stamina maximum. A creature without a Stamina resource receives no secondary benefit.

source.originalText: Renewal: Healing Rites restore 5 stamina to the target.

cards.name: Flame
cards.rangeAndTarget: One creature damaged by your Smite or Rite
cards.frequency: At most once on each of your turns
cards.effect: Invocation Path — Flame. Tags: invocation, flame. Immediately after your Smite or Rite damages a creature, you may spend 1 Conviction. The target ignites and takes 1d6 fire damage at the start of each of its next 2 turns. Reapplying Flame refreshes the duration; the burning damage does not stack.

source.originalText: Flame: Conviction can be consumed to ignite targets for 2 turns (fire DoT).

cards.name: Veil
cards.frequency: Automatic only if Veil was selected
cards.effect: Invocation Path — Veil. Tags: invocation, veil, sight. You can see invisible and ethereal creatures and objects within 30 feet that are not behind total cover. This does not reveal mundane disguises, automatically defeat illusions, or let you see through opaque barriers.

source.originalText: Veil: Gain passive True Sight vs invisible or ethereal creatures.

cards.name: Echoes
cards.duration: Until start of your next regular turn
cards.frequency: At most one pending Echoes-path repeat
cards.effect: Invocation Path — Echoes. Tags: invocation, echoes. Once on each of your turns after a Smite or Rite produces rolled immediate damage or healing, store one original target and that raw dice total. At the start of your next regular turn, if the target is legal, repeat floor(raw dice total/10), minimum 1 for a positive total, as the same damage or healing type. This repeat carries no conditions, resources or triggers.

source.originalText: Echoes: 10% of healing or damage is repeated 1 turn later (Echo Effect).

cards.name: Divine Smite
cards.effect: Divine Smite. Tags: smite, divine. Make a Cleric technique attack against one enemy. On a hit, deal S d8 + M radiant damage. This is one damage event. Invocation Path bonuses and features explicitly referring to Smite may modify it.

source.originalText: Divine Smite: Channel divine energy into a powerful strike against a single enemy, dealing damage based on your Wisdom and consuming 1 Conviction.

cards.name: Healing Rite
cards.effect: Healing Rite. Tags: rite, healing. One living ally regains S d8 + M HP. It cannot restore a dead creature or remove Wounds. Consecrated Ground and appropriate Invocation Path bonuses may modify this healing.

source.originalText: Healing Rite: A channeled ability that restores health to an ally, with increased effectiveness on consecrated ground.

cards.name: Sacred Chant
cards.effect: Sacred Chant. Tags: chant, sustained, conviction. Pulse on start and once when maintained on each later regular turn with a Bonus Action. source.originalText: Sacred Chant: A sustained prayer that generates 1 Conviction every 3 turns while maintained.

cards.name: Consecrate
cards.rangeAndTarget: 15-foot-radius fixed zone centered at a point within 30 feet
cards.effect: Consecrate. Tags: rite, zone. Create sanctified terrain. Your Consecrated Ground feature recognizes this zone. Undead creatures in the zone have -1 on attack rolls. source.originalText: Consecrate: Sanctify the ground in a 15-foot radius, creating consecrated terrain that enhances your healing abilities and weakens undead enemies.

cards.name: Divine Insight

cards.effect: Divine Insight. Tags: ritual, information. cards.name: Aura of Faith

cards.effect: Aura of Faith. Tags: aura, bishop. Allies in the aura gain +1 on saving throws. Whenever your Rite restores HP to an ally in the aura, that ally also regains 1 additional HP. Multiple Aura of Faith bonuses do not stack.

source.originalText: Aura of Faith: Allies in range gain +5% healing received and +1 to saves.

source.originalText: Sermon of Purpose: Chants now generate 1 Conviction every 2 turns.

cards.name: Liturgical Flow

cards.name: Anointed Guardian

source.originalText: Anointed Guardian: First time an ally drops below 20% HP per combat, grant them a 30% damage reduction shield for 2 rounds.

cards.name: Sanctified Reprisal
cards.duration: Until end of your next regular turn

After one of your Cleric features restores HP to a living creature, empower your next Divine Smite before the end of your next regular turn. On a hit it deals S d4 additional radiant damage. source.originalText: Sanctified Reprisal: Whenever you heal, next Smite deals 20% more damage and stuns Undead.

cards.name: Miraculous Channel
cards.rangeAndTarget: Your next ally-targeting Rite this turn

Your next Rite this turn that normally affects one or more willing allies may affect up to six legal willing allies within the Rite's normal range instead. cards.name: Bishop's Mandate
cards.rangeAndTarget: Your Sacrament and one legal Divine Invocation target set
cards.frequency: Automatic at Cleric 9; once per Sacrament start

cards.name: Divine Invocation
cards.effect: Divine Invocation. Tags: invocation, bishop. Use only your selected Invocation Path. Radiance: up to 3 allies within 30 feet each regain S d8+M HP; one may end Frightened or Poisoned. Judgment: one enemy within 60 feet makes a Wisdom save, taking (S+1)d8 radiant on failure or half on success; failure also applies Judged for 2 rounds. cards.name: Sacrament

cards.name: Banish Unholy

source.originalText: Mass Healing Light: Channel divine energy to heal all allies within 30 feet, with increased effectiveness on those most wounded.

cards.name: Divine Intervention
cards.effect: Divine Intervention. Tags: saint, emergency. Trigger when the ally either fails a saving throw or takes damage that would reduce it to 0 HP. Choose one: the ally rerolls the failed save and must use the new result; or reduce the triggering damage by 2 S d8 + M, minimum 0. This cannot negate an event that has already fully resolved.

source.originalText: Divine Intervention: Call upon your deity to intervene directly, potentially averting disaster or creating a miraculous effect.

cards.name: Sanctify Being
cards.effect: Sanctify Being. Tags: saint, protection. Choose one mode. Elemental Sanctity grants resistance to one of acid, cold, fire, lightning, necrotic, poison, radiant or thunder. Purity grants immunity to exactly one of Charmed, Frightened or Poisoned. Choose when activated; the choice cannot change during that use.

source.originalText: Sanctify Being: Bestow temporary divine protection on an ally, granting them immunity to specific conditions or damage types.

cards.name: Radiant Burst
cards.rangeAndTarget: 15-foot radius centered on you; up to six allies and six Undead/Fiends
cards.effect: Radiant Burst. Tags: saint, healing, radiant. Roll S d8 once. Each chosen living ally regains that roll + M HP. Each chosen Undead or Fiend makes a Wisdom save, taking the same S d8 roll as radiant damage on failure or half on success. Healing and damage are separate applications of the shared roll.

source.originalText: Radiant Burst: Release a powerful wave of divine energy that heals allies and damages unholy creatures.

cards.name: Resurrection
cards.rangeAndTarget: One allied corpse you touch that died within the previous 1 minute
cards.effect: Resurrection. Tags: saint, resurrection, rite. Return the target to life at 1 HP and grant it 2 S + M temporary HP for 1 minute. It gains no removed Wounds and receives no restored expended resources beyond what another rule explicitly provides. A missing vital body prevents the effect. The Conviction expenditure can vent Dissonance once.

source.originalText: Resurrection: Return a fallen ally to life with renewed vigor and temporary divine blessing.

cards.name: Scriptural Echo
cards.rangeAndTarget: One legal original target of your previously used Divine Invocation
cards.effect: Scriptural Echo. Tags: priest, rite, invocation. When you start a Rite, you may repeat 50% of the immediate rolled damage or healing dice from the most recent Divine Invocation you personally resolved since the end of your previous regular turn. Round down once, minimum 1 for a positive source. It copies no conditions, movement, resource effects, control or Invocation Path triggers.

source.originalText: Scriptural Echo: Casting a Rite repeats the Invocation used previously for 50% effect.

cards.name: Words of Equilibrium
cards.effect: Words of Equilibrium. Tags: priest, scaling. For numeric Cleric technique healing and damage that would add your Wisdom modifier, use the higher of your Intelligence or Wisdom modifier instead. M becomes max(1, that higher modifier) for those numeric effects. This does not change Cleric attack rolls or save DCs unless another rule explicitly says so.

source.originalText: Words of Equilibrium: Heal and Damage dealt scale off the higher of INT or WIS.

cards.name: Balanced Scales
cards.rangeAndTarget: Living creatures healed by your Cleric features
cards.duration: Until start of your next regular turn
cards.frequency: At most once per marked ally per round
cards.effect: Balanced Scales. Tags: priest, healing, retaliation. After you restore HP to a living ally, mark it until the start of your next regular turn. The first enemy to damage that ally during the mark takes S + M radiant damage. The retaliation is not an attack, cannot critically hit and cannot recursively trigger another Balanced Scales event.

source.originalText: Balanced Scales: Enemies take divine damage if they attack healed targets.

cards.name: Doctrine Shield
cards.effect: Doctrine Shield. Tags: priest, conviction, cleanse. During a real encounter, when one of your Cleric features successfully removes Charmed, Frightened, Poisoned or another explicitly removable condition from a living creature, gain 1 Conviction. Removing multiple conditions in the same event still grants only 1 Conviction.

source.originalText: Doctrine Shield: Gain 1 Conviction anytime a condition is removed.

cards.name: Word of Binding
cards.rangeAndTarget: Up to six enemies within 30 feet
cards.effect: Final Miracle — Word of Binding. Tags: priest, finale, control, rite. Each target makes a Wisdom save. On failure it is Silenced and its Speed becomes 0. At the end of each of its turns it repeats the save, ending both effects on success. While a target remains bound, the first instance of divine or radiant damage it takes each round gains S d6 additional radiant damage. The Conviction expenditure can vent Dissonance once.

source.originalText: Final Miracle: Word of Binding: Enemies in a large AoE are silenced, snared, and take +25% divine damage for 3 turns.

cards.name: Balance Restoration
cards.rangeAndTarget: 15-foot-radius area centered at a point within 30 feet
cards.effect: Balance Restoration. Tags: priest, healing, radiant. Choose up to three living allies and three enemies in the area. Roll S d8 once. Each ally regains the roll + M HP. Each enemy makes a Wisdom save, taking the same S d8 roll as radiant damage on failure or half on success.

source.originalText: Balance Restoration: Channel divine energy that both heals allies and damages enemies in an area, maintaining cosmic balance.

cards.name: Divine Judgment
cards.effect: Divine Judgment. Tags: priest, judgment. The target makes a Wisdom save; success ends the attempt. On failure it is marked. The first time on each of its turns that it deals damage to another creature, it takes radiant damage equal to half that actual damage rounded down, minimum 1, maximum your Cleric level. It repeats the Wisdom save at the end of each turn, ending the mark on success.

source.originalText: Divine Judgment: Mark an enemy for judgment, causing them to take damage proportional to the harm they inflict.

cards.name: Ritual of Cleansing
cards.rangeAndTarget: Up to three living allies within 30 feet; secondary enemies within 15 feet of you
cards.effect: Ritual of Cleansing. Tags: priest, rite, cleanse. Each ally may end one of Charmed, Frightened or Poisoned. For each distinct condition actually removed, choose one enemy within 15 feet; each chosen enemy makes a Wisdom save. On failure it becomes Frightened of you until the end of its next turn. One enemy can be chosen only once per use.

source.originalText: Ritual of Cleansing: Perform a ritual that removes multiple negative conditions from allies while potentially imposing them on enemies.

cards.name: Word of Power
cards.effect: Word of Power. Tags: priest, divine. Choose one mode. Mercy: one willing living creature regains S d8+M HP. Rebuke: one Undead or Fiend makes a Constitution save, taking (S+1)d8 radiant on failure or half on success; failure also removes its Reaction until the start of its next turn. Command: one other hostile creature makes a Wisdom save; failure knocks it Prone and removes its Reaction until the start of its next turn. No mode changes beliefs, loyalty or ideology.

source.originalText: Word of Power: Speak a divine word that has different effects based on the target's nature and actions.

cards.name: Cosmic Equilibrium
cards.effect: Cosmic Equilibrium. Tags: priest, zone, healing, radiant.
